scope: Read-only public source provenance hashing before one source reconstruction

events.error: The filename or extension is too long. (os error 206)
events.cause: Six already-read public sources were aggregated into an oversized shell argument

events.error: JavaScript execution exceeds the 64000-byte strict auto-review limit
events.cause: Aggregate public source payload exceeded the tool input bound

resolution: Inspect exact payload lengths; hash one source per bounded Node in-memory call using the already-fetched public bytes; all six match pinned SHA256
prevention: Do not embed aggregated source payloads in shell commands or oversized tool inputs; bound each metadata operation and return only hashes and byte counts
